name: Lazy Cheetah 23
author: vinodjangid07
description: Gradient rounded cyan toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: transform becomes translateX(100%), background-color changes from #cecece to #7cadce.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Lazy Cheetah 23</title>
<style>
/* Lazy Cheetah 23 by vinodjangid07 — https://uiverse.io/vinodjangid07/lazy-cheetah-23 */
#checkboxInput {
  display: none;
}

.toggleSwitch {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  width: 90px;
  height: 30px;
  background-color: rgb(206, 206, 206);
  border-radius: 40px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition-duration: .3s;
}

.toggleSwitch::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  height: 30px;
  width: 50%;
  left: 0px;
  background: conic-gradient(rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.555),white,rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.555),white,rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.555));
  border-radius: 40px;
  transition-duration: .3s;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.281);
}

#checkboxInput:checked+.toggleSwitch::after {
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition-duration: .3s;
}

#checkboxInput:checked+.toggleSwitch {
  background-color: rgb(124, 173, 206);
  transition-duration: .3s;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input id="checkboxInput" type="checkbox">
    <label class="toggleSwitch" for="checkboxInput">
    </label>

</body>
</html>
